prompt.text: Do these steps in order, each with its own tool call, calling the tools directly: 1) use the write tool to create a.md containing hello. 2) use the edit tool to replace hello with bye in a.md. 3) use the shell tool to run: echo hi. 4) use the subagent tool to ask a subagent to reply with the word OK, without tools. Then say DONE.

You are a subagent spawned by another session.
Reply with the word OK only. Do not use any tools.
